name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000MG Jarz - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Sour Watermelon Lemonade
description: Enjoy sweet n’ sour with Double-Stacked Sour Watermelon Lemonade BITEZ. Two bold layers fuse mouth-puckering sour watermelon with bright, zesty lemonade for a refreshing sweet-and-sour flavor with plenty of citrusy pucker. Each double-stacked gummy packs a powerful 1,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (10 gummies per jar, 10,000mg total). A refreshing heavy-hitter built for serious sour cravings.
